The Kubernetes Services API provides an abstraction for exposing groups of Pods over a network with a stable virtual IP address and DNS name. Services decouple consumers from the pod IPs, enabling load balancing across pod replicas and supporting ClusterIP, NodePort, LoadBalancer, and ExternalName service types for internal and external connectivity within Kubernetes clusters.
